description: Carter was a decorated member of the New York City Police Department, having earned two Excellent Police Duty Awards, and was honored by the Staten Island Advance in 1995 after stopping a knife-wielding robber who preyed on senior citizens riding elevators at the Stapleton Houses. As a community leader, Carter was involved with the department’s youth explorers program and coached a youth softball league.
